title: 終電のあとで
artist: サンセット・パレード
caption: 1980s Japanese city pop and AOR, smooth and mellow. Warm, relaxed male lead vocal in Japanese with layered falsetto harmonies in the chorus. Clean electric guitar with chorus effect, melodic bass, steady drums, glassy digital electric piano, soft synth strings, a tasteful melodic electric guitar solo. Nostalgic, gentle, walking home through the sleeping city. Polished analog studio production.
lyrics:
[Intro]
